# Bundled Preview Code Notice

This directory contains only the upstream code needed by the active preview paths. Model weights and full upstream repository histories are not stored here.

- LiteVGGT: `https://github.com/GarlicBa/LiteVGGT-repo`, commit `4767c17f8b6f176bb751566e92f60eb885040033`, MIT.
- EDGS: `https://github.com/CompVis/EDGS`, commit `9a897645eb47c1b24d4f9e4428cd745927bf1ee1`, non-commercial academic/personal use.
- Spark: `https://github.com/sparkjsdev/spark`, commit `3cf9fa15adb7ac7c47a1e962740db97b9e8a9fdf`, MIT.

Model weights are mounted through `model-cache`.
